description.en: The number of layers to return.
The token that marks the start of the next page of results.
Specifies whether the layer is an official layer. Valid values: true and false.
The prefix of the layer name.
Specifies whether the layer is public. Valid values: true and false.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc list-layers --prefix my-layer --next-token MTIzNCNhYmM= --limit 10 --public true --official true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fc GET /2023-03-30/layers --region cn-hangzhou --public true --prefix 'my-layer' --nextToken 'MTIzNCNhYmM=' --limit 10 --official true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
